coverage_issues: qwen model failed to review .gitignore due to an API error (HTTP 400 BadRequestError).
learnings: Transient API errors on non-critical files (like .gitignore) should not force an overall 'inconclusive' verdict if the security-critical files (PKGBUILD, .SRCINFO, .install) are successfully audited and found safe.
